answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital commitment. An agent cannot simply invent a fable of identity to gain weight; instead, it must lock collateral. Like a falcon tracking its target, the network utilizes a verifiable random beacon to select proposers, ensuring security. An attacker incurs the direct cost of massive asset acquisition, rendering unauthorized duplication economically ruinous rather than a trivial zero-cost exploit.
